edits.old: Then a redelivered batch row starts no second workflow run
edits.new:
Then a redelivered batch row starts no second workflow run

  Scenario: AC15 No COMPLETED batch by the expected-by time (BR2; legacy RWB-E1-015 AC2)
    Given DP01 has no COMPLETED batch for business date 2026-11-30 at 08:00
    When the freshness step runs at 08:00
    Then DP01 is flagged stale
    Then AceDataLate is published for DP01

  Scenario: AC16 The batch row is FAILED (BR3; legacy RWB-E1-015 AC4)
    Given the batch row for DP01 for business date 2026-11-30 reads FAILED at 05:20
    When the freshness step runs
    Then DP01 is flagged stale at once
    Then the previous stamp stays in use
    Then no daily job starts

  Scenario: AC17 The same COMPLETED batch row is read twice (BR6; legacy RWB-E1-015 AC5)
    Given the batch row for DP01 for business date 2026-11-30 is COMPLETED
    When the same batch row is read twice
    Then one data_product_load row exists for DP01 for 2026-11-30
    Then the repeat is counted in duplicate_count
    Then no second AceDataReady event is published

  Scenario: AC18 A late batch arrives after the stale flag (legacy RWB-E1-015 AC6)
    Given DP01 is STALE for business date 2026-11-30
    When the batch row for DP01 for 2026-11-30 completes at 08:40
    Then DP01 is LOADED with the new loaded_at
    Then the daily jobs start for business date 2026-11-30
